message: sixmax action vocabulary is config-defined (TOML, BB/pot units, order=config order); checkpoints embed vocab hash, loaders refuse mismatches
boundary rescale rule corrected: divide chip inputs by table big blind (their_stack/100 only coincided at 100BB); fixed in openpoker_bot.py and scaffold docs

Phase 1a solver core merged to feature/neural-cfr (99d6203): GameState/Game interface, ES-MCCFR w/ linear weighting (Kuhn -1/18 gate), 2-6p NLHE engine + settle_pots (300-scenario oracle cross-validation), EngineGame vocab-masked bridge. 1b seams: per-thread Game instances (new_hand mutates button_), MCCFRTrainer table accessor for checkpoints, setup_dev.sh pybind11-symlink hardening.

Plan-defect fix: PotManager.contribute() records but never deducts player.stack — oracle helpers must deduct explicitly (p.stack -= c) before comparing net payoffs. Bit us in the Phase 1a settlement property test.

Buck2 gotcha: exported_preprocessor_flags propagate one hop only; //common:evaluator moved to exported_deps of neural_cfr:core so the bindings target inherits card.h include path (pre-existing break from Phase 0 evaluator extraction).

Phase 1b blueprint pipeline merged to feature/neural-cfr (3c670d6, 10 commits): 169-class preflop + deterministic equity-percentile abstraction, bit-packed table-size-agnostic infoset keys (live_opps/after encoding: MP 6-handed == UTG 5-handed), multithreaded BlueprintTrainer (Kuhn-gated 1t+4t), SIXBP001 checkpoints w/ vocab-hash refusal, train_sixmax.py + eval_sixmax.py w/ best-checkpoint selection. 178 tests. Executed via opus orchestrator subagent driving haiku/sonnet workers.

Key design invariant: equity bucket lookups must use the SAME salt as quantile-edge sampling (Abstraction cfg seed) or percentile calibration diverges from lookups; hand_equity is deterministic per (sorted hole, sorted board, salt) by construction — never cache-dependent.
